title: What To Cut To Afford Getting In Shape
hook: You're not broke. You're spending your money on the wrong things.
body: Bars and clubs, restaurants, junk food in the house, vacations. Cut those for a few months and you'll have more than enough to spend on your fitness. Never cut healthy food, your mattress or the basic bills. It's a short-term sacrifice, and you'll be so glad you did it.

youtube_description:
You're not broke. You're spending your money on the wrong things. In part 2 of this series I show you exactly what to cut so you can spend more on your health, and the three things you should never cut.

See what you'd look like with a six-pack, free:
https://absbyai.com/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=longform&utm_content=ro20b-what-to-cut

Never cut: healthy food, your mattress, and the basic necessities like rent and utilities.

What to cut:
1. Bars and clubs (and the 30 rack of beer at home)
2. Eating at restaurants
3. Junk food in the house
4. Vacations, until you're ripped
5. Therapy and psychiatric medication, if you can't afford a gym membership (my opinion, not medical advice)
Plus subscriptions, your car payment, new clothes and expensive dates.

It's a short-term sacrifice. A few months from now you'll be in better shape, more productive, and glad you did it.

Part 1: why you should invest more in your health (link added once it's live). Part 3, what to buy for your health at every income level, comes out next.
